summary.name: NextDNS
summary.one_liner: NextDNS is a cloud-based DNS firewall that blocks security threats, ads and trackers, and provides parental controls across devices and networks.
use_cases: block ads and trackers on all devices
protect home network from malware and phishing
set up parental controls for kids
encrypt DNS queries on phones and computers
monitor which services apps connect to
limit access to sites or games during set hours
summary.what_it_does: NextDNS filters DNS queries to block malware, phishing, cryptojacking and other threats using threat intelligence feeds, plus ads and trackers using popular blocklists. It offers parental controls such as category blocking, SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted Mode enforcement, and Recreation Time schedules. Analytics and real-time logs show device activity, with log retention from one hour to two years or logging disabled, and selectable log storage regions (United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Switzerland). It supports DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-TLS, custom denylists and allowlists, DNS rewrites, and DNSSEC validation.
notable: Filters at the DNS level so it adds no CPU, memory or battery load on the device
Configurable log retention from one hour to two years, with selectable data residency regions
Parental controls with Recreation Time schedules and SafeSearch/YouTube Restricted Mode enforcement
Described by users as a cloud-hosted Pi-hole alternative
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on this page
Handshake root naming support is described as experimental
Mac listing in awesome-mac marks it as freeware with an App Store link, but the page itself does not state pricing
